content.user_title: Audit On-Page SEO for One Page
content.value_statement: Single-page SEO problems can hide in titles, headings, links, images, and page tags. This skill gives Claude, Codex, or Claude Code a structured audit workflow with prioritized fixes.
actual_capabilities: Scores title tags, meta descriptions, headers, keyword usage, internal links, images, and page-level tags.
Infers a preliminary target keyword when the user has not supplied one.
Labels evidence as measured, user-provided, or estimated to prevent unsupported claims.
Produces P0, P1, and P2 repair priorities with an overall page score.
Supports competitor comparisons when the user provides competing page URLs.
Supports bulk audits by clustering URLs, sampling pages, and reporting pattern-level findings.
limitations: It is not a full crawl, indexing, Core Web Vitals, or technical SEO checker.
It does not validate search volume or ranking data unless the user supplies tool exports.
It may need pasted HTML when a page blocks fetches or depends on client-side rendering.
It gives quick E-E-A-T signals, not a full publish-readiness verdict.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Ranking Drop
use_cases.description: Audit one page after traffic drops and identify structural fixes before rewriting the content.

use_cases.title: Review Draft Content
use_cases.description: Check a draft for title, meta, heading, keyword, link, and image issues before publication.

use_cases.title: Compare Against Competitors
use_cases.description: Compare one page with competing URLs and find gaps in structure, metadata, links, and page elements.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a single published URL and no competitor set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the on-page SEO for this URL: [URL]. Use the visible page content and explain each priority fix.

prompt_templates.title: Keyword-Focused Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the target keyword is known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this page for the target keyword [keyword]: [URL or pasted content]. Score each on-page section and rank fixes by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when evaluating why another page may perform better.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare on-page SEO for [our URL] against [competitor URL] for [keyword]. Highlight gaps in metadata, headings, content structure, links, and images.

prompt_templates.title: Bulk Pattern Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for many related URLs from one section or template.
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk audit these URLs: [URL list]. Cluster by page type, sample representative pages, report pattern-level issues, and prioritize portfolio fixes.

output_examples.input: A product roundup page targeting best noise cancelling headphones.
output: Overall score: 71 out of 100 with the largest gaps in internal links and image alt text.
P0 fix: add descriptive alt text to product images and link product names to detailed reviews.
P1 fix: rewrite the meta description with a clearer benefit and call to action.

output_examples.input: A draft article with no supplied keyword.
output: Target keyword was inferred from the title, H1, first paragraph, and repeated section topics.
The audit is marked as done with concerns until keyword demand is validated.
Recommended next step: confirm the keyword with search volume or search console data.

output_examples.input: A list of 40 blog URLs for one site section.
output: The URLs are grouped into blog posts, guides, comparison pages, and landing pages.
Sample findings are extrapolated only at the cluster level and include confidence notes.
Portfolio priorities separate template fixes from single-page improvements.

best_practices: Provide the page URL, target keyword, page type, and business goal before starting the audit.
Confirm whether evidence is measured, user-provided, or estimated before acting on recommendations.
Use the priority list to fix blocking SEO issues before lower-impact copy improvements.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for full technical SEO crawling or Core Web Vitals diagnosis.
Do not treat inferred keywords as validated search demand.
Do not report client-side schema as missing until the rendered DOM has been checked.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits title tags, meta descriptions, headings, keyword placement, links, images, page tags, and basic page structure.

faq.question: Can it audit pages without a target keyword?
faq.answer: Yes. It infers a preliminary keyword from the page and marks the result as needing keyword validation.

faq.question: Does it replace technical SEO tools?
faq.answer: No. Use a technical SEO checker for crawl, indexing, Core Web Vitals, mobile rendering, and site-wide diagnostics.

faq.question: Can it compare competitors?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide your URL, a competitor URL, and a target keyword for a structured comparison.

faq.question: Can it handle many URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports bulk mode by clustering URLs, sampling representative pages, and reporting pattern-level findings.

faq.question: What should users provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the URL or HTML, target keyword, page type, business goal, and any competitor URLs or SEO tool exports.
